rawRef.description: The reference exactly as authored — unresolved

text.description: Link text for a markdown form, or null for a bare autolink or any lexer-derived form

column.description: 1-based column. Null for a markdown form derived from an AST node that carries no column.

startOffset.description: 0-based UTF-16 code-unit offset of the reference token in the decoded content — NOT characters and NOT bytes; an astral character advances it by two

endOffset.description: 0-based UTF-16 code-unit offset one past the reference token — the half-open span [startOffset, endOffset)

syntacticForm.description: Syntactic form of a reference candidate, as a lexer sees it

hasExtension.description: The token ends in a dot followed by a short alphanumeric run

slashCount.description: Number of "/" characters in the token

anyOf.description: Variable-expansion syntax present in a reference token

variableExpansion.description: Which expansion syntax the token uses, or null when it contains none

inCodeSpan.description: True when the reference sits inside an inline code span

inFence.description: True when the reference sits inside a fenced code block

projection-blob-references.description: A row of the blob-keyed `blob_references` table
